recipe.title: Oaty caramel slice
recipe.notes: This is a Jo Seagar recipe.
recipe.prep: Preheat oven to 180 deg C. Spray and line a large 25 x 35 cm slice or sponge roll tin, with a good overhang.

method.s: Combine dry ingredients for base in a bowl.
Add the eggs and melted butter.
Mix well, then press two-thirds of the mixture into the prepared tin.
Slowly melt the butter, sweetened condensed milk and golden syrup together.
Mix well, then add vanilla essence.
Sprinkle the remaining crumbly mixture on top of the filling.
Cool and refrigerate. (It's best to slice it once it's fully cooled.)
